t: You're looking at the Queen's Court Building, part of the Royal Courts of Justice in Westminster. It was designed by Eric Bedford, a twentieth-century architect whose most famous work is London's BT Tower. Construction of that tower began in 1961, when it was called the Post Office Tower, and Bedford was Chief Architect. It was completed in 1965 at 177 metres, and for a time it was the tallest building in London.
